title: Community conference preparation plan
summary: Seven workstreams on an eight-week axis, with deliberate overlaps and three dated milestones.
prompt: Draw a paper-style Gantt chart for our eight-week community conference run-up, weeks starting Mon Apr 5 2027. Venue and date lock W1-W2. Call for talks open W3-W5, starting after the venue is locked. Talk review and scheduling W5-W6. Speaker confirmations W7, after review. Tickets and promotion W3-W8. Volunteer recruiting and briefing W5-W7. Walkthrough and event week W8, after the volunteer briefing. Milestones: call for talks closes end of W5, schedule published end of W6, doors open Sat May 29. Show a week-number axis.
